label: Native encryption at rest
type: Couchbase Server's built-in encryption of data on disk, as opposed to encryption provided by the filesystem or storage layer beneath it. An Enterprise Edition feature.
note: Head of the encryption-at-rest family. The docs are careful to call it *native* to distinguish it from filesystem-level encryption, and the registry keeps that adjective in the id for the same reason: 'encryption at rest' unqualified is true of a great many deployments that have this feature switched off.
